remarks: Discover refined living in this meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhouse nestled within the sought-after Heritage Common community. One of 12 units, spanning approximately 2,863 sq. ft., this residence is a harmonious blend of comfort and sophistication. The home offers an open-concept design, with a sunlit living room featuring a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The gourmet chef's kitchen is fully equipped with modern stainless steel appliances, including an induction range, custom cabinetry, and a large quartz island.  Upstairs, retreat to the expansive primary suite complete with a luxurious en-suite bath with radiant floors. Two additional bedrooms provide space for family, guests, or a home office. A finished lower level and a private outdoor patio extend your living and entertaining options. Located just minutes from premier shopping, dining, and top-rated schools, this exceptional home offers both convenience and community. A must-see!
